# Alexander Display & Packaging

> The complete one-stop marketing solution for businesses in Houston, TX and the greater Texas area. Founded in 2007.

Alexander Display & Packaging is a Houston, Texas-based marketing products company specializing in large-format printing, custom packaging, point-of-purchase displays, vehicle wraps, and branded marketing materials. We serve businesses of all sizes — from new startups to established brands, restaurants to retailers.

## About

- **Founded:** 2007
- **Location:** 5902 Sovereign Dr., Unit A, Suite A05, Houston, TX 77036
- **Phone:** (281) 686-8602
- **Website:** https://alexanderdisplay.com
- **Service Area:** Houston, TX and greater Texas

## Products & Services

- **Vehicle Wraps** — Full wraps, partial wraps, fleet graphics, and decals for cars, vans, trucks, and trailers
- **Banners & Signs** — Pop-up banners, mesh banners, yard signs, A-frame signs, and billboards
- **Point of Purchase Displays** — Floor displays, countertop units, sidekick fixtures, and shelf talkers for retail environments
- **Folding Cartons** — Custom retail packaging boxes; structural design, prototyping, and production
- **Marketing Kits** — Branded kits combining print materials, promotional products, and packaging
- **Protective Packaging** — Foam inserts, corrugated packaging, and specialty solutions for fragile or high-value products
- **Wall Murals & Window Graphics** — Custom wall murals, perforated window film, floor graphics, and environmental branding
- **Canvas & PVC Printing** — High-resolution printing on canvas, PVC banners, sintra board, and specialty substrates

## Additional Services

- Graphic Design — Logos, layouts, and print-ready artwork
- 3D Rendering — Visualize displays and packaging before production
- Fulfillment Services — Storage, kitting, and distribution of marketing materials
- Assembly Instructions — Clear documentation for complex display systems

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does Alexander Display & Packaging do?**
We provide marketing products and custom packaging for businesses — vehicle wraps, banners, retail displays, folding cartons, marketing kits, protective packaging, wall murals, and large-format printing.

**Where are you located?**
Houston, TX — 5902 Sovereign Dr., Unit A, Suite A05, Houston, TX 77036.

**Do you serve businesses outside Houston?**
Yes. While we are based in Houston, TX, we serve clients throughout Texas and ship nationally.

**How do I get a quote?**
Fill out the quote form at alexanderdisplay.com or call (281) 686-8602. We respond within one business day.

**How long have you been in business?**
Since 2007 — over 17 years serving Houston-area businesses.
